description: This file implements the API endpoints related to shopping cart operations in a food ordering system, using FastAPI. It provides routes for adding, retrieving, updating, and deleting cart items, and includes internal helper functions for calculating subtotals and enriching cart item data.

methods.name: float _compute_subtotal(items: list[CartItem])
methods.description: Calculates the subtotal of cart items by summing their price multiplied by quantity, rounding to two decimal places.

methods.name: list[CartItem] _enrich_cart_items(repo: SupabaseRepository, raw_items: list[dict])
methods.description: Enriches raw cart item data by attaching detailed menu item information when available, returning a list of CartItem instances.

methods.name: AddToCartResponse add_to_cart(payload: AddToCartRequest, ctx: AuthContext = Depends(require_auth))
methods.description: API endpoint to add an item to the user's cart, performing an upsert operation after verifying the menu item exists.

methods.name: CartResponse get_cart(ctx: AuthContext = Depends(require_auth))
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve the current authenticated user's cart items along with the subtotal.

methods.name: CartItem update_cart_item( item_id: str, payload: UpdateCartItemRequest, ctx: AuthContext = Depends(require_auth) )
methods.description: API endpoint to update the quantity of a specific cart item.

methods.name: None delete_cart_item(item_id: str, ctx: AuthContext = Depends(require_auth))
methods.description: API endpoint to delete a specific cart item from the user's cart.

ctags.name: add_to_cart
ctags.pattern: /^def add_to_cart(payload: AddToCartRequest, ctx: AuthContext = Depends(require_auth)) -> AddToCar/

ctags.name: delete_cart_item
ctags.pattern: /^def delete_cart_item(item_id: str, ctx: AuthContext = Depends(require_auth)) -> None:$/

ctags.name: update_cart_item
ctags.signature: ( item_id: str, payload: UpdateCartItemRequest, ctx: AuthContext = Depends(require_auth) )
